module_summary: PTP periodic output generator: a 3-state FSM compares the registered PTP time against a next-edge timestamp and schedules rising/falling edges using start, period and width config registers with ns-overflow lookahead adders.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/UPDATE_RISE/UPDATE_FALL controller sequencing edge comparison and next-edge computation

anchors.name: next_edge_s_reg
anchors.why: Next scheduled edge time (seconds) compared against current time to trigger output

anchors.name: next_rise_s_reg
anchors.why: Holds last rising-edge time used as base for period and width additions

anchors.name: time_s_reg
anchors.why: Registered PTP time seconds sampled from input_ts_96 each cycle for edge compare

anchors.name: period_s_reg
anchors.why: Programmable output period, loaded on input_period_valid, added to rise time

anchors.name: width_s_reg
anchors.why: Programmable pulse width, loaded on input_width_valid, sets falling edge time

anchors.name: start_s_reg
anchors.why: Programmable start time loaded into next rise/edge on restart or time step

anchors.name: ts_96_ns_ovf_reg
anchors.why: Overflow lookahead sum minus 1e9 ns; sign bit selects seconds increment

anchors.name: ts_96_ns_inc_reg
anchors.why: Rise time plus period or width ns sum used when no seconds carry

anchors.name: restart_reg
anchors.why: Set by start/period config writes; reloads edge times from start registers

anchors.name: ffwd_reg
anchors.why: Fast-forward flag skipping past edges after restart until time catches up

anchors.name: level_reg
anchors.why: Current output level; selects period versus width addition and next state

anchors.name: output_pulse
anchors.why: Generated periodic pulse output driven by output_reg

anchors.name: locked
anchors.why: Indicates output is locked after first scheduled rising edge

anchors.name: error
anchors.why: Reports a timestamp step disturbed the schedule

anchors.name: input_ts_96
anchors.why: 96-bit PTP timestamp input sampled into time registers

anchors.name: input_ts_step
anchors.why: Timestamp step event forcing schedule reload and error flag

anchors.name: input_start_valid
anchors.why: Write enable loading start config registers and triggering restart

anchors.name: input_period_valid
anchors.why: Write enable loading period config registers and triggering restart

anchors.name: input_width_valid
anchors.why: Write enable loading width config registers

groups.name: Edge scheduler FSM
groups.description: FSM waits for edge time, toggles output level, triggers next-edge updates and restarts

groups.name: Edge time datapath
groups.description: Compares current time to next edge and computes next edge with ns overflow lookahead

groups.name: Configuration registers
groups.description: Start, period and width timestamps loaded by their valid strobes

groups.name: Output and status
groups.description: Pulse output plus locked and error status driven from registers
